TRAFFIC ADVISORY

IN CONNECTION WITH JANAMASTHMI CELEBRATION AT  PRACHEEN SHRI HANUMAN MANDIR, CIVIL LINES ON 16.08.25 

A Janamasthmi Celebration program is being held by Pracheen Shri Hanuman Mandir Committee on 16.08.2025 from 1930 hours at Pracheen Shri Hanuman Mandir Civil Lines  Delhi.
Due to the Celebration, traffic will remain affected on  Prof N.D Marg on 16.08.2025 from 07:00 PM onwards for general road users except emergency vehicles.

DIVERSION POINTS: -

Ramjas College Red Light
Prof N.D Marg - Bungalow Road T-Point.

All vehicles will be diverted from the above points as and when required.

ALTERNATE ROUTE:-

Traffic coming from Sudhir Bose Marg  and Chhatra Marg on Prof. N.D Kapoor Marg:-

The traffic destined to  Prof N.D Kapoor Marg from Chhatra Marg and Sudhir Bose Marg will be diverted to Sudhir Bose Marg and then take Guru Teg Bahadur Marg to reach their destinations.

Traffic coming from Malka Ganj Chowk on Prof. N.D Kapoor Marg:-

The traffic destined to  Prof N.D Kapoor Marg from Malkaganj Chowk will be diverted to Bungalow Road and then take Guru Teg Bahadur Marg  and Satyawati Marg to reach their destinations.

INSTRUCTIONS TO GENERAL PUBLIC: -

Commuters are advised to avoid the above roads.
Avoid roadside parking as it causes hindrance to normal flow of traffic.

data.raw_text:
Most infra talks about scaling like it’s stacking servers.
@theblessnetwork scales like a swarm every new node adds muscle and mind.

A browser node in Manila runs AI inference.
An old gaming rig in Berlin powers ZK proofs.
A budget Android in Nairobi processes DEX orders.

All real time.WASM sandboxed. Fault tolerant.

I’ve watched it self heal mid task four nodes drop in one country traffic reroutes instantly. No central controller.

This isn’t just efficiency it’s immunity.

No kill switch. No gatekeepers. No boardroom deciding who gets compute.

And the best part?
Once you own your compute rail you can run anything AI agents games on chain apps no permission slip required.

Bless isn’t pitching the future.
It’s quietly building it behind the scenes right now.
